# STORY Rabat

> A luxury boutique hotel in Rabat, Morocco offering curated accommodations, fine dining, wellness experiences, and event facilities blending Moroccan artistry with contemporary hospitality.

STORY Rabat is a five-star boutique hotel destination in Morocco's capital city, featuring distinctive suites and villas with Moroccan design elements, multiple dining venues, spa and wellness facilities, and comprehensive event spaces. The hotel caters to luxury travelers seeking authentic Moroccan experiences with modern amenities.
